claims.claim_text: 論文把 keepalive——週期性戳一下讓 cache 別被逐出——建成一個經濟學模型，回答它在什麼負載形狀下省下的大於自己的花費。
claims.evidence: "A client-side keepalive, replaying the prefix on a timer during the pause, prevents this, and it is individually rational"; breakeven "~46 min for Anthropic, ~36 min for OpenAI and DeepSeek" — the paper builds the economic/breakeven model of periodic keepalive against re-prefill cost for paused agentic turns.
claims.note: The paper gives a breakeven threshold rather than an exhaustive load-shape enumeration, but the lede's characterization ('經濟學模型，回答它在什麼負載形狀下省下的大於自己的花費') is a fair summary of the modeled question.

claims.claim_text: 算出各家的損益兩平閒置時長：Anthropic 約 46 分鐘、OpenAI 與 DeepSeek 約 36 分鐘、Google 只有約 12 分鐘。
claims.evidence: Full text (arxiv.org/html/2607.19214v1): "Break-even against re-prefill is Imax=τ(w/r−1): ≈46 min for Anthropic's 5-minute tier, ≈36 min for OpenAI and DeepSeek, and only ≈12 min for Google, whose implicit cache reads at 0.25× rather than 0.1×." All four per-provider breakeven idle times in the reworded lede match the cited paper verbatim.
claims.note: Round-2 re-check: the lede was reworded to attribute the breakeven times (Anthropic ~46 / OpenAI ~36 / DeepSeek ~36 / Google ~12 min) to the cited arXiv paper, and the unsourced mempko '8x' figure was moved to the deep story (the roundup lede now only says '深入文章再對照 mempko 跨四家的實測', asserting no number). The abstract gives Anthropic/OpenAI/DeepSeek; the full-text HTML additionally confirms the ≈12 min Google figure. Now fully supported at the stated strength.

claims.claim_text: 產出了一個 Jacobian 猜想的候選反例，再由數學家消化與驗證
claims.evidence: "Levent posted on X that Fable had found a counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture"; the author then formalizes/compiles the 1076-line Lean file to verify ("I scanned over the 1076-line Lean file … I then compiled it" → "At this point I knew that we had a counterexample"). Confirms an LLM produced the candidate and a human/tool verified it. Post title itself: "Human mathematicians are being outcounterexampled", supporting Buzzard's characterization.
claims.note: Source confirms an Anthropic model (Fable) produced the counterexample; it does NOT mention OpenAI models, so the lede's parenthetical '（Anthropic 與 OpenAI 的模型）' is only partly supported by this source (the OpenAI attribution is uncorroborated here). Core claim — LLM candidate + human verification — is fully supported.

claims.claim_text: Kevin Buzzard 在部落格把這件事講成「人類數學家正在被反例打敗」。關鍵是分清楚兩件事：AI 負責生成 candidate，人類與工具負責驗證。
claims.evidence: Post title: "Human mathematicians are being outcounterexampled" — supports Buzzard's framing '人類數學家正在被反例打敗'. Epistemic point (AI generates candidate, humans/tools verify): "Levent posted on X that Fable had found a counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture" + "Paul Lezeau had already formalized the counterexample manually" + the author scanning/compiling the 1076-line Lean file to check it.
claims.note: Round-2 re-check: the round-1 fix dropped the two unsupported attributions — 'Terence Tao 技術拆解' and 'OpenAI 的模型' — from the lede. The lede now asserts only Buzzard's framing + the counterexample + the epistemic candidate/verification point, all confirmed against this source. The one remaining Tao mention is a forward reference to the deep story ('深入文章補上 Terence Tao 的獨立消化與第二來源'), not an attribution to this cited source, so it is out of scope for this item and would be verified in the deep-story ledger.

claims.claim_text: 逐一開關 hyphenation、protrusion（標點懸掛）、expansion、tracking 等微排版特性，還附一個把畫面模糊化的 squint test 來檢查間距是否勻稱
claims.evidence: Feature toggles listed verbatim on the page: "hyphenation," "protrusion," "expansion," "tracking," "hang punctuation"; "blur (squint test)" offered under compare controls; "Tap & hold anywhere to reveal the browser rendering" enables native-vs-own comparison. "Publication-grade text justification for the web."

claims.claim_text: 逐一開關 hyphenation、protrusion（標點懸掛）、expansion、tracking、hang punctuation 等微排版特性，還附一個把畫面模糊化的 squint test…讓你即時對比瀏覽器原生的 justify 與它自己的排版。這類最佳化斷行的想法可追到 Knuth-Plass。
claims.evidence: Feature toggles present verbatim on the page: "hyphenation", "protrusion", "expansion", "tracking", "hang punctuation"; plus "blur (squint test)" under the compare controls. Browser-vs-own comparison confirmed: the page compares "browser" rendering against "justif" rendering with a reset control. The page does NOT name "Knuth" or "Knuth-Plass" anywhere.
claims.note: Round-2 re-check: the round-1 fix removed the false claim that the page names 'Knuth-Plass' (dropped from both the H2 title and lede). The title now reads '把出版級斷行與微排版帶進瀏覽器', and the lede lists the on-page feature toggles (all confirmed verbatim) while framing Knuth-Plass as the general line-breaking technique ('這類最佳化斷行的想法可追到 Knuth-Plass') — a durable algorithmic-history statement, no longer attributed to the page. Feature list fully supported by the cited source.

claims.claim_text: 讓 16 個 Claude 實例併發協作，寫出一個約 10 萬行 Rust 的 C 編譯器，能跨多種架構編譯 Linux kernel。… 前後跑了約 2,000 個 session、花了約 2 萬美元 API 費用，測試通過率達 99%，還建置出可開機的 Linux 6.9。
claims.evidence: "16 agents"; "100,000-line compiler"; "can build a bootable Linux 6.9 on x86, ARM, and RISC-V"; "nearly 2,000 Claude Code sessions"; "total cost just under $20,000"; "99% pass rate on most compiler test suites". Limitations acknowledged: "generated code is not very efficient", "It lacks the 16-bit x86 compiler", "not yet a drop-in replacement" — matching the lede's caveat about remaining gaps.

claims.claim_text: 用 Lean 這個證明輔助器帶你寫出機器可檢查的數學證明，第一部分以形式驗證 One-Time Pad 當作實例。它從 bitstring 與 XOR 函式這些基礎切入，順帶介紹 Lean 的隱式參數、lambda 與 vector 型別等語法。
claims.evidence: "we'll do a walkthrough the very basics of Lean and then formally verify the One-Time Pad (OTP) protocol"; bitstrings: "we don't have to fix bit string length `L`"; implicit args: "parameter `L` is implicit"; lambda: "fun x => x + 1"; vector: "The predefined type `Vector α n`"; audience: "cryptographic engineers who are new to formal verification or want to refresh their knowledge of the basics".

claims.claim_text: 有 .pub 時 client 會先試探，沒有時 OpenSSH 直接送出完整簽章請求，而 GitHub 更新後的伺服器顯然會拒絕後者。修法是把公鑰補回來：ssh-keygen -y -f ~/.ssh/github_rsa > ~/.ssh/github_rsa.pub。
claims.evidence: "With a `.pub` file present, the client first _probes_ (offers the public key, waits for the server's OK) and only then signs. With only a private key, OpenSSH skips the probe and sends a fully signed authentication request directly." Fix command verbatim: "ssh-keygen -y -f ~/.ssh/github_rsa > ~/.ssh/github_rsa.pub". Diagnosis: "My `~/.ssh/github_rsa` has lived without a companion `.pub` file … Generating one made authentication work again".

claims.claim_text: SWE 類 benchmark 上 K3 拿 92.4%、Fable 92.6%——但把兩者用 router 智慧分流後，整體準確率能推到 93%。… 單用 K3 最多比單用 Fable 省下約 50 倍成本，oracle router 把 72–96% 的流量都導向 K3。
claims.evidence: "K3 gets 92.4%, Fable 92.6%"; "We achieved 93% accuracy with routing between K3 and Fable."; "K3 … lands to the left (the more cost-effective side) of Fable … in all five task-families."; "up to ~50X more cost effective than Fable alone on long agentic loops."; "The oracle router choose K3, 72-96% of task traffic."; "About 1,030 tasks in all, in real agent loops."

claims.claim_text: 每個模型、每種格式、每個位置，完美回應率都在 N=80 條指令時歸零；context 一旦逼近上限，模型不是亂編（fabrication 為 0）而是大量拒答（refusal 從 0% 飆到 79–90%）。… 換格式還會多吃 22–37% 的 token。
claims.evidence: "Perfect-response rate collapses to zero by N=80 for every model, format, and placement."; "Fabrication never occurs (0/5,760 probes)"; "What rises sharply near each model's context ceiling is outright refusal to answer (0% to 79-90%)."; "No model shows a reliable markdown advantage; one 35B model favors plain text instead"; "token overhead (+22% to +37% over plain text)."

claims.claim_text: Linux kernel 正在用 eBPF 版的 binfmt_misc，加上動態選擇 interpreter 的能力，讓像 Nix 這種需求能在執行期覆寫 PT_INTERP。… loader substitution 的 L flag，只做 PT_INTERP override 而不換掉 process 身分。
claims.evidence: "leverage eBPF as a programmable way to select an interpreter through binfmt_misc"; transparency problem: "The registered interpreter becomes the process. It owns the entire process identity…"; L flag: "With the `L` flag, the kernel executes the matched binary natively as the main image, and merely substitutes the registered interpreter for the loader named in the binary's `PT_INTERP`." → "binfmt_misc stops being a hand-off and becomes a plain `PT_INTERP` override."
claims.note: The lede's opening definition of $ORIGIN ('會解析成執行檔所在目錄的 placeholder') is not stated verbatim in the source, but the source's mechanism (BPF program with '$ORIGIN' support in PT_INTERP/shebang) is consistent with it; the load-bearing 'what changed' claim about the eBPF binfmt_misc + L-flag dispatch is fully supported.

claims.claim_text: 把一顆亂序（out-of-order）多處理器實作，形式驗證為滿足一個順序性（in-order）的弱記憶體模型 ISA 規格。
claims.evidence: Title: "Formal Verification of an Out-of-Order Multiprocessor against an In-Order Weak-Memory ISA"; abstract: "We present the first formal verification of an out-of-order multiprocessor against an in-order, weak-memory ISA."; reordering: "intra-core out-of-order execution, in which instructions fire out of program order" and "weak outcomes, which no sequential execution explains"; refinement framing: "a core refinement, proving a core implementation against this specification".
claims.note: The lede also names 'store buffer' as a reorder source; the fetched abstract confirms out-of-order execution and weak outcomes but does not explicitly mention store buffers (likely in the full paper). This is a low-load elaboration; the core verification claim is fully supported.
